integrity: Original model, Lambert roots, and qualitative bistability credited to 2022 primary literature; stable-manifold curvature and two-term area law proved here, with finite numerical checks only as corroboration.
scientific_limitations: Only fixed positive parameters satisfying the strict two-simple-root condition and b<d; deterministic small-square asymptotic, not stochastic demographic extinction. The double-root surface, b>=d, large squares, and delays are excluded.
title: A sharp two-term small-population extinction-basin law for an exponential ratio-dependent predator–prey flow
